
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/toutou/p/18877249/SpringBoot_data_compress" title="发布于 2025-10-08 19:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SpringBoot进阶教程(八十七)数据压缩</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="bodyCustomClass">
<div class="bodyCustomClass">
<blockquote>
<p>最近在使用Redis的时候，经常遇到一些不常用的大key，对存储有一些负担。就想着把大key压缩一下。压缩可以分很多种，比如拆分JSON字符串​， ​​压缩JSON字符串​，优化JSON体积​，流式处理大型JSON​和分段存储。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="_nav_0" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>拆分JSON字符串​</h2>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">1.1按结构拆分​</div>
<p>数组拆分​​：若JSON包含大型数组，可将其拆分为多个小数组。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 示例：将大数组拆分为多个子数组</span>
JSONArray bigArray = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSONArray(jsonString);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> chunkSize = 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 0; i &lt; bigArray.length(); i +=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chunkSize) {
    JSONArray chunk </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSONArray();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> j = i; j &lt; Math.min(i + chunkSize, bigArray.length()); j++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        chunk.put(bigArray.get(j));
    }
    String chunkJson </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chunk.toString();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理或保存chunkJson</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p>​​对象拆分​​：若JSON是嵌套对象，可按层级拆分为子对象。</p>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">1.2按大小拆分（流式处理）​​</div>
<p>使用流式API（如Jackson的JsonParser）逐块读取JSON内容，避免一次性加载到内存：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>JsonFactory factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonFactory();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (JsonParser parser = factory.createParser(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> File("large.json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (parser.nextToken() != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逐Token处理，如按特定条件拆分</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="_nav_1" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>压缩JSON字符串​</h2>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">2.1使用GZIP压缩​</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] compress(String data) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IOException {
    ByteArrayOutputStream bos </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayOutputStream(data.length());
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (GZIPOutputStream gzip = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GZIPOutputStream(bos)) {
        gzip.write(data.getBytes());
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bos.toByteArray();
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 压缩后的数据可用于传输或存储</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] compressed = compress(jsonString);</pre>
</div>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">2.2使用Deflater压缩​</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.zip.Deflater;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] deflateCompress(String data) {
    Deflater deflater </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Deflater();
    deflater.setInput(data.getBytes());
    deflater.finish();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] buffer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[1024<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
    ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayOutputStream();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">deflater.finished()) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> count =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deflater.deflate(buffer);
        outputStream.write(buffer, </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, count);
    }
    deflater.end();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> outputStream.toByteArray();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="_nav_2" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>优化JSON体积​​</h2>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">3.1移除无用空格​</div>
<p>使用紧凑格式（无缩进、换行）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> JSONObject(jsonString).toString(); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认紧凑格式</span></pre>
</div>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">3.2​​缩短键名​</div>
<p>将长字段名替换为短名称：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>{"n":"Alice","a":30} <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 原始键名可能为"name"、"age"</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="_nav_3" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>流式处理大型JSON​​</h2>
<p>使用流式API逐步解析，避免内存溢出：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Jackson流式API示例</span>
JsonFactory factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonFactory();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (JsonParser parser = factory.createParser(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> File("large.json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))) {
    JsonToken token;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> ((token = parser.nextToken()) != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (token ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonToken.START_ARRAY) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (parser.nextToken() !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逐条处理数组元素</span>
                JsonNode node =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.readValueAsTree();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理node...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="_nav_4" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>分页处理​</h2>
<p>其实也是拆分，将数据拆成若干份</p>
<h2 id="_nav_5" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>实践方案</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.io.IOException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Base64;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CompressHelper {

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> ObjectMapper objectMapper = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectMapper();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 方式1：去除JSON中的空格/换行等冗余字符（文本压缩）
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> formattedJson 格式化的JSON字符串（含空格换行）
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 紧凑格式的JSON字符串
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> IOException JSON解析异常
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> String compressJsonByRemovingSpaces(String formattedJson) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IOException {
        JsonNode jsonNode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> objectMapper.readTree(formattedJson);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> objectMapper.writeValueAsString(jsonNode);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 方式2：使用GZIP算法对JSON字符串进行二进制压缩（适合网络传输）
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> json 原始JSON字符串
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Base64编码的压缩后字符串（可直接传输）
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> IOException 压缩异常
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> String compressJsonByGzip(String json) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IOException {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (ByteArrayOutputStream byteOut = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayOutputStream();
             GZIPOutputStream gzipOut </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GZIPOutputStream(byteOut)) {

            gzipOut.write(json.getBytes(</span>"UTF-8"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
            gzipOut.finish();

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Base64.encodeBase64String(byteOut.toByteArray());
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> String decompressJson(String source) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IOException {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] compressedData =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Base64.decodeBase64(source);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (ByteArrayInputStream byteIn = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayInputStream(compressedData);
             GZIPInputStream gzipIn </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GZIPInputStream(byteIn);
             ByteArrayOutputStream byteOut </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ByteArrayOutputStream()) {

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取压缩数据并解压缩</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] buffer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[1024<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> ((len = gzipIn.read(buffer)) != -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                byteOut.write(buffer, </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, len);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> byteOut.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
